blocks.text: Data science woh field hai jo data collect karne, us ka analysis karne aur us se mufeed maloomat nikalne par kaam karti hai. Yeh raw data (kacha, be-tarteeb data) ko kaam ke ilm mein badalti hai. Data science tools aur tareeqon se bohat bara data parakhti hai. Yeh zindagi ke kai shobon mein decision-making (faisla karne) mein madad deti hai, aur future trends (aane wale rujhan) ka andaza lagane mein bhi. Business, taleem aur healthcare (sehat) mein is ka aam istemal hai. Aaj ki technology bohat had tak data science par chalti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Bohat se idare (organizations) faisle karne ke liye data science istemal karte hain. Yeh data mein chhupe trends aur patterns (baar baar aane wale naqsh) samajhne mein madad deti hai.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure chaar card aik qatar mein, har aik mein tasveer: Data Collection (Gathering & Processing: jama aur process), Data Analysis (Exploring & Cleaning: parakh aur safai), Modeling (Training & Testing) aur Decision Making (Insights & Actions: baseerat aur amal). Oopar Feedback Loop wali kaman (arc) Data Collection se Decision Making tak, aur neeche wapsi ki kaman Decision Making se Data Collection tak.

blocks.long_description: Tasveerein: database aur clipboard magnifier ke saath (Data Collection); pie aur bar charts magnifier ke saath (Data Analysis); neural network aur gear (Modeling); bulb aur checklist (Decision Making).

blocks.text: Data science ka matlab hai data ko parh kar patterns aur mufeed maloomat dhoondna. Is mein mukhtalif sources (zaraye) se data jama kiya jata hai. Analysis se pehle data ko saaf aur tarteeb mein kiya jata hai. Analysis ke baad results (nataij) ko dhyan se samjha jata hai. Data science sawalon ke jawab facts aur data se deti hai, is liye faislon mein guesswork (andaze se kaam chalana) kam ho jata hai. Data science ka poora workflow (kaam ke qadmon ka silsila) Figure 6.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Data science data ko knowledge (ilm) mein badalti hai, aur yeh ilm asal zindagi ke masle hal karne mein kaam aata hai.

Data science kai subjects ka ilm milati hai. Mathematics se numbers aur hisab ka kaam hota hai. Statistics (shumariyat) data ka analysis aur khulasa karne mein madad deti hai. Computer science tools aur programming ki maharat deti hai. Domain knowledge (us shobe ka ilm jis ka masla hai, jaise tib ya business) asal masla samajhne ke liye zaroori hai. Communication skills (baat samjhane ki salahiyat) se results saaf saaf bataye jate hain. Isi milap ki wajah se data science ko interdisciplinary (kai shobon ko milane wali) kehte hain. Har shoba doosre ki madad karta hai, aur sab mil kar data analysis ko zyada asar-dar banate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Figure 6.1 ke chaar qadam: (1) Data Collection: data jama aur process karna; (2) Data Analysis: data ko dekhna aur saaf karna; (3) Modeling: model ko train aur test karna; (4) Decision Making: results se faisle aur amal. Tasveer mein oopar wali kaman (Feedback Loop) Data Collection se Decision Making tak jaati hai, aur neeche wali kaman Decision Making se wapas Data Collection tak aati hai. Feedback Loop ka matlab: results se naye sawal paida hote hain aur kaam phir pehle qadam se shuru hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Data science ko interdisciplinary kyun kaha jata hai? Domain knowledge ki ek misal dein jo is ke liye zaroori ho.
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh mathematics, statistics, computer science, domain knowledge aur communication ko milati hai. Misal: hospital ke data ke analysis ke liye tibbi (medical) ilm chahiye, taake pata ho ke kaun si measurements aham hain aur result ka mareezon ke liye kya matlab hai.

items: Data science raw data ko faislon aur andazon ke kaam aane wale ilm mein badalti hai.
Workflow: data collection, data analysis (dekhna aur safai), modeling (train aur test), decision making; feedback loop se kaam dobara shuru.
Interdisciplinary: mathematics, statistics, computer science, domain knowledge aur communication.
